MATCH (hub:Spec {specNumber: '38.423'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND EXISTS { MATCH (:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub) }
MATCH (rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)

WHERE s.level = 1
